title: aaas.carry.propagated.v1
description: Published by carry once per propagated carry of a task, after the propagation is recorded in its Mnesia log. Audit trail of the carries of the Peano arithmetic: a successor call whose units digit wraps from 9 to 0 produces one of these events. No service consumes it yet.

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Addition task the carry was propagated for; never null for this event.

payload.description: The request and the result of one carry propagation (CarryService.Propagate).

digits.description: Decimal digits of the number before the carry, least significant first (index 0 is the units digit).

position.description: Index of the digit that received the carry, from 0 to the number of digits; equal to the number of digits when a new most significant digit was created.

result.description: Decimal digits after the carry, least significant first: the number plus 10 to the power of position. One element longer than digits when the carry passed the highest digit.
